protocol: original Wong 171 train, 67 calibration, 102 previously reused developmental test
estimator: character 3-5 gram TF-IDF + 5-category logistic regression on all 3 vet votes per training case; optional one-hot veterinarian intercept
selection_metric: calibration Brier versus empirical three-vet vote frequencies (lower better); ties use fewer urgent escalations
action_policy: highest P(Immediate) threshold giving >=5 of six majority-immediate calibration cases, minimize Immediate escalations
finding: Adding rater-specific intercepts did not win calibration model selection; calibration chose pooled expert-vote classifier. This DOES NOT imply expert bias is nonexistent.
cautions: source contains no animal patient ID or independent site
test cases previously heavily used, not prospective blinded ranking
threshold calibrated using just six majority-immediate cases
reference is clinician opinions not patient outcomes
no raw clinical cases, vocabulary or model checkpoint shared
